title: Custom Subscripts: Matrix
hints: A subscript can take several parameters and have both a getter and a setter.
Store a flat array and map `(row, col)` to `row * cols + col`; check bounds with `precondition`.
`static func *` loops `i`, `j`, `k`: `out[i, j] += a[i, k] * b[k, j]`.
jsBridge: Custom subscripts with two parameters (`m[row: 1, col: 2]`) have no JS equivalent (only `m[1][2]` or Proxy tricks). `precondition` checks bounds and traps like Swift's own array subscript.
